Centre Plans Automated Airport NOC System to Speed Up Clearances

The Central government is planning to overhaul the No Objection Certificate (NOC) process for construction near airports, aiming for automated clearances within 15 days. This move is intended to simplify and expedite the current complex system. The proposed automated system is expected to make building near airports easier.
